questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: In which year did Swami Vivekananda deliver his historic speech at the Chicago Parliament of Religions?
questions.explanation: Swami Vivekananda delivered his famous speech at the Chicago Parliament of Religions on 11 September 1893, beginning with the words "Sisters and brothers of America."

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The Bhopal gas tragedy occurred in which year?
questions.explanation: The Bhopal gas tragedy occurred on the night of 2-3 December 1984, when methyl isocyanate gas leaked from the Union Carbide plant, killing thousands.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Who takes the salute during the Republic Day parade at New Delhi?
questions.explanation: The President of India takes the salute during the Republic Day parade as the Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Reni Village in Garhwal was known for which environmental movement in the 1970s?
questions.explanation: Reni Village in Garhwal was the site of the Chipko Movement, where villagers hugged trees to prevent deforestation, led by environmentalist Sundarlal Bahuguna.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: In which year was the National Food Security Act enacted in India?
questions.explanation: The National Food Security Act (NFSA) was enacted in 2013, providing subsidized food grains to approximately two-thirds of India's population.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which Indian city hosted the first meeting of the Employment Working Group of G20?
questions.explanation: The first meeting of the Employment Working Group of G20 was conducted in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, focusing on global employment and skill development issues.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: When was the post of National Security Advisor created in India?
questions.explanation: The post of National Security Advisor was created in India in 1998, with Brajesh Mishra being the first NSA appointed under Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: In which year was the first meeting of the National Integration Council held?
questions.explanation: The first meeting of the National Integration Council was held in 1962, following the recommendations of the Committee on National Integration and the creation of the council under the chairmanship of Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The 'Silk City' of India, known for its famous silk sarees, is located in which state?
questions.explanation: Kanchipuram in Tamil Nadu is known as the 'Silk City' of India for its exquisite handwoven silk sarees, which are famous worldwide.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which Indian finance minister was India's delegate to the World Monetary Conference at Bretton Woods in 1944?
questions.explanation: Sir C.D. Deshmukh was India's delegate to the Bretton Woods Conference in 1944, where the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank were established.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: In which year was yoga inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity?
questions.explanation: Yoga was inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2016 during the 11th session of the Intergovernmental Committee held in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: When was the Currency Building in the BBD Bagh area of Kolkata constructed?
questions.explanation: The Currency Building in the BBD Bagh (Dalhousie Square) area of Kolkata was constructed in 1833 and is a heritage building that once served as the office of the Currency Department.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: In which year were two additional Commissioners appointed to the Election Commission of India for the first time?
questions.explanation: Two additional Commissioners were appointed to the Election Commission of India for the first time in 1989, making it a multi-member body. Currently, the Election Commission comprises the Chief Election Commissioner and two Election Commissioners.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: In which year was 'Ramlila' inscribed on the UNESCO Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity?
questions.explanation: Ramlila was inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2008, recognizing the traditional performance of the Ramayana epic across North India.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: When was the Secretariat of the SAARC set up?
questions.explanation: The Secretariat of the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC) was set up in 1987 in Kathmandu, Nepal, after the establishment of the organization in 1985.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: In which year was the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) established?
questions.explanation: The National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) was established in 1992 as the first demutualized electronic exchange in India, revolutionizing the country's capital markets.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: When was the foundation stone for the Gateway of India laid in Bombay (now Mumbai)?
questions.explanation: The foundation stone for the Gateway of India was laid in 1905 to commemorate the visit of King George V and Queen Mary to India. The monument was completed in 1924.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: In which year was the Rigveda manuscript included in UNESCO's Memory of the World Register?
questions.explanation: The Rigveda manuscript was included in UNESCO's Memory of the World Register in 2007, recognizing its outstanding universal value as one of the oldest religious texts.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: In which year was the PIN Code (Postal Index Code) introduced in India?
questions.explanation: The PIN Code (Postal Index Code) was introduced in India on 15 August 1972 by the Indian Postal Service, comprising six digits to facilitate efficient mail sorting and delivery.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: When was the first underground section (Vishwavidyalaya - Kashmere Gate) of the Delhi Metro's Red Line opened?
questions.explanation: The first underground section of the Delhi Metro's Red Line (Vishwavidyalaya - Kashmere Gate) was opened in 1997, marking a significant milestone in Delhi's public transportation.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: India signed a contract with which country for deep-sea mineral exploration in the Indian Ocean in October 2025?
questions.explanation: India signed a contract with China for deep-sea mineral exploration in the Indian Ocean in October 2025, focusing on polymetallic nodules and other valuable resources.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: In which country was India elected as the Chairman of the AIBD Executive Board?
questions.explanation: India was elected Chairman of the AIBD (Asia-Pacific Institute for Broadcasting Development) Executive Board in Thailand, reflecting India's growing leadership in global media and broadcasting.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which country elected its first woman Prime Minister in October 2025?
questions.explanation: Nepal elected its first woman Prime Minister in October 2025, with Sushila Karki taking oath as the country's first female head of government.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: What is the name of India's first reusable hybrid rocket launched by a Tamil Nadu-based startup?
questions.explanation: RHUMI-1 is India's first reusable hybrid rocket, launched by Tamil Nadu-based startup Space Zone India, marking a milestone in India's private space sector.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: What is the name of India's first 25-qubit Quantum Processing Unit (QPU) launched in 2025?
questions.explanation: India launched its first 25-qubit Quantum Processing Unit (QPU) in October 2025, named IITQ-25, developed by IIT Madras in collaboration with leading research institutions.

questions.explanation: A is father of B and C (since B and C are siblings). C is son of D. So D is the mother of C, and hence wife of A.

questions.subject: General Intelligence & Reasoning
questions.question: Three different positions of a dice are shown below: Position 1: Top=1, Front=2, Right=3. Position 2: Top=4, Front=2, Right=1. Position 3: Top=3, Front=5, Right=4. Which number is opposite to the face having number '2'?
questions.explanation: From Positions 1 and 2, 2 is common (front in both). Adjacent to 2: In Pos1, adjacent to 2 are 1 and 3. In Pos2, adjacent to 2 are 4 and 1. So adjacent to 2 = 1, 3, 4. Therefore, opposite to 2 is the remaining number from 1 to 6, which is 5 (and 6 if 6 is there). Since numbers are 1,2,3,4,5,6, opposite to 2 is 5.

questions.explanation: Ephemeral' means lasting for a very short time. Its antonym is 'Permanent', which means lasting forever or indefinitely.

questions.explanation: Benevolent' means well-meaning and kindly. Its antonym is 'Malevolent', which means having or showing a wish to do evil to others.
